newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt shares up as market emerges from holiday.
newsitem.headline: Egypt shares up as market emerges from holiday.

text.p: Egypt's all-share index on Tuesday continued to ascend on the back of the state's privatisation of a cotton firm as the market emerged from the Islamic Eid al-Fitr feast.

The bourse had ended the trading week last Thursday breaking through the 400 point level for the first time. On Tuesday it rose 4.7 points to close at 406.34, its 16th record level in as many trading days, the Capital Market Authority (CMA) said.
Turnover was 46.6 million pounds ($13.7 million), boosted by the state's sale of 132,900 shares in Nile Cotton Ginning for 6 million pounds, the CMA said.
"It was probably a continuation of last week," said broker Neveen al-Tahry of Delta EAB.

On Thursday, turnover was swollen by the sale to strategic investors for 2.896 million shares in Nile Cotton Ginning worth 128.036 million pounds. The state's Holding Company for Cotton and International Trading had offered at least 1.2 million of the six million shares in the company.
Brokers said in general the market was quiet as it emerged from the two-day weekend followed by Sunday and Monday bank holidays for the Eid al-Fitr.
"I expect it to stay shallow for the coming days," said borker Elwy Taimour of EFG Hermes.
Nile Cotton Ginning shares closed at 48.00 pounds, up five.
Abu Qir Fertilisers and Chemical Industries was the second most active share with 5.8 million pounds worth changing shares. Its share closed up one pound at 98.
Four of the popular milling shares were among the other top ten in terms of turnover. Central Egypt Flour Mills was the best performing in its sector, rising 2.44 pounds to 81.15.
East Delta Flour Mills rose 2.25 pounds to 97.00 in trade worth about 2.8 million pounds.
The index for openly traded firms rose to 673.89 points from 665.27 points on Thursday and the index for rarely traded "closed" firms rose to 268.82 from 265.93 points.
Out of the 77 shares traded, 41 gained, 15 lost and 21 ended the day unchanged.
